app_calendarHelp: You can't create a poll without any options. Add at least one option to continue.
app_commentPlaceholder: Leave a comment on this poll (visible to everyone)
app_deletePollDescription: All data related to this poll will be deleted. To confirm, please type <s>“{confirmText}”</s> in to the input below:
app_deletingOptionsWarning: You are deleting options that participants have voted for. Their votes will also be deleted.
app_demoPollNotice: Demo polls are automatically deleted after 1 day
app_descriptionPlaceholder: Hey everyone, please choose the dates that work for you!
app_endingGuestSessionNotice: Once a guest session ends it cannot be resumed. You will not be able to edit any votes or comments you've made with this session.
app_errorCreate: Uh oh! There was a problem creating your poll. The error has been logged and we'll try to fix it.
app_guestSessionNotice: You are using a guest session. This allows us to recognize you if you come back later so you can edit your votes.
app_linkHasExpired: Your link has expired or is no longer valid
app_loginMagicLinkSent: A magic link has been sent to:
app_loginViaMagicLinkDescription: We'll send you an email with a magic link that you can use to login.
app_loginWithValidEmail: Please enter a valid email address
app_mixedOptionsDescription: You can't have both time and date options in the same poll. Which would you like to keep?
app_notificationsOnDescription: An email will be sent to {email} when there is activity on this poll.
app_notificationsVerifyEmail: You need to verify your email to turn on notifications
app_noVotes: No one has voted for this option
app_pollOwnerNotice: Hey {name}, looks like you are the owner of this poll.
app_shareDescription: Give this link to your participants to allow them to vote on your poll.
app_specifyTimesDescription: Include start and end times for each option
app_unverifiedMessage: An email has been sent to {email} with a link to verify the email address.
common_footerSponsor: This project is user-funded. Please consider supporting it by donating.
errors_notFoundDescription: We couldn't find the page you're looking for.
homepage_adFreeDescription: You can give your ad-blocker a rest — You won't need it here.
homepage_commentsDescription: Participants can comment on your poll and the comments will be visible to everyone.
homepage_heroSubText: Find the right date without the back and forth
homepage_metaDescription: Create polls and vote to find the best day or time. A free alternative to Doodle.
homepage_mobileFriendlyDescription: Works great on mobile devices so participants can respond to polls wherever they may be.
homepage_noLoginRequiredDescription: You don't need to login to create or participate in a poll
homepage_notificationsDescription: Keep track of who's responded. Get notified when participants vote or comment on your poll.
homepage_openSourceDescription: The codebase is fully open-source and available on GitHub.
homepage_selfHostableDescription: Run it on your own server to take full control of your data
homepage_timeSlotsDescription: Set individual start and end times for each option in your poll. Times can be automatically adjusted to each participant's timezone or they can be set to ignore timezones completely.
